paragraphs: Legacy Mark has sold software and services to cemetery professionals since 1987. Its offering runs from databases and accounting tools to field services. Products named on the site include Cemetery Office Management, CemMap Cemetery Mapping, Cemetery Accounts Receivable, and Data Entry and Migration.

Field services listed include Ground Penetrating Radar, Photo Documentary of Markers, GIS Map Development, Database Development from Markers, and Online Map Hosting. A version released in 2024 is described as helping cemetery owners migrate cards and books into a database and convert an existing database. Other listed options are hosting customer information online and help checking or adjusting data.
The pages name the buyers as cemetery professionals, and list Church Cemeteries, Nonprofit Cemeteries, and Public Cemeteries as the core of them.

quote.text: The cemetery software choice for cemeteries nationwide!
